scope: Six preselected independent spine CT anatomies with synthetic parallel targets; no acquired X-ray or clinical generalization claim.
target_model: Independent spatial trilinear ray quadrature at half minimum resampled voxel spacing; same attenuation array, no Fourier target.
metric: mTRE on every provided vertebral centroid in physical CT-lattice coordinates. Below2mm descriptive criterion.
preprocessing: Clamp(HU+1000)/3000 to[0,1], trilinear resampling align_corners=True, preserve endpoint physical coordinates and report spacing.
optimizer: Adam, cosine learning-rate decay to10%, best target-image loss retained; no reference pose in optimization.
cuda_acceptance: Torch vs actual Triton forward/6parameter gradient relativeL2: float32<1e-4/3e-3; fp16,bf16<1e-2/2e-2. No default kernel change.
reporting: Retain all six cases and24 outcomes, including failures. Padding2 is fidelity sensitivity only; no outcome-driven configuration selection.
